title: Add GPT-5.4 to LLMs
description: Add GPT-5.4 to the AllowedLLMs array in repo/cli/main.go to make it available throughout the repo system.
summary: Successfully added GPT-5.4 to the AllowedLLMs array in repo/cli/main.go. The new LLM is now available throughout the repo system with the --gpt-5-4 flag. The change has been tested and confirmed working - the flag appears in the help output for ticket open command and the CLI builds successfully.
